purpose: Establish the documentation/architecture foundation (DS-001-014 Core Codex, now DS-015-023 expansion foundation).
required_features_summary: Complete Features System governance; DS-015-023 skeletons.
excluded_features_summary: No product code required at this stage.
entry_criteria: Core Codex (DS-001-014) approved and independently verified.
exit_criteria: Expansion foundation (this pass) internally consistent and reviewed.
major_risks: Documentation drift/inconsistency if governance is weak.

purpose: Build the deterministic core (market data, indicators, backtesting, database, scanner) on Windows desktop.
required_features_summary: Market data ingestion; indicator engine; backtesting engine; database; scanner; deterministic execution authority. Founder Sage Developer Mode groundwork (FEAT-0268, Founder-only, private).
excluded_features_summary: No cloud, no multi-user, no mobile/web.
exit_criteria: Core backend modules implemented and tested (evidence: tests/test_market_data_*, tests/test_indicator_*, tests/test_backtest_*, tests/test_scanner*, tests/test_database.py).
major_risks: Underestimating provider-abstraction groundwork needed for later cloud migration.

purpose: A usable, Founder-facing paper-trading alpha: proposals, risk validation, basic charts, journaling groundwork.
required_features_summary: Trade proposal generation; deterministic risk engine; portfolio tracking; basic charting; paper trading.
excluded_features_summary: No live trading, no customer accounts.
exit_criteria: Founder can run a full propose-validate-paper-execute-journal loop.
major_risks: Scope creep into premature UI polish before the core loop is proven.
estimated_duration_range: approximately 6-10 months total from current date

purpose: Daily Founder use of the full local workstation, including Founder Local Sage and Founder-only research tooling.
required_features_summary: Founder Local Sage; saved chart layouts; versioned strategies/indicators; Founder-only Python research extensions. Usable private Founder Sage Developer Mode (FEAT-0268).
exit_criteria: Founder relies on DarkSage for real daily research/trading workflow.
major_risks: Founder-only assets not yet structurally isolated from a future customer build.

purpose: First customer-facing beta: cloud Sage, web dashboard, mobile companion apps, subscriptions in beta.
required_features_summary: Customer Cloud Sage; web account/dashboard; iOS/Android companion apps (beta); device trust/MFA; subscription billing (beta); grace mode; incident/recovery center (beta).
excluded_features_summary: No public marketplace, no institutional routing.
entry_criteria: Stage 3 Founder Workstation proven daily-usable; edition boundary mechanism implemented.
exit_criteria: A cohort of beta customers completes the full onboarding-to-paper-trading loop in the cloud.
dependencies: Stage 3; DS-015 edition boundary; DS-017 local/cloud architecture.
major_risks: Cloud Sage cost exposure; synchronization/conflict-resolution defects.

purpose: General-availability commercial launch per the explicit Initial Release Boundary.
required_features_summary: See docs/features/DARKSAGE_COMPLETE_FEATURES.md Initial Release Boundary section (initial_release_required=Yes features).
excluded_features_summary: Full Pine Script competitor; public strategy marketplace; public social network; 100+ drawing tools; every global exchange; every exotic chart type; institutional routing; white-label SDK; advanced public copy trading; public paid signal marketplace.
entry_criteria: Stage 4 beta cohort successfully onboarded with no unresolved Critical/High defect.
exit_criteria: General commercial availability across Windows, web, iOS, Android for U.S. stocks/ETFs and selected options intelligence.
dependencies: Stage 4; DS-019 commercialization; DS-021 security/device-trust; DS-023 reliability.
major_risks: Billing defects; kill-switch reliability; regional commercial-restriction gaps.

purpose: Incremental delivery of advanced trading capability after initial release (multi-account, automation maturity, advanced exits).
required_features_summary: Multi-user workspaces; multi-account trading; delegated approvals; strategy-driven automated entries; advanced heatmaps/news features.
excluded_features_summary: Still no public marketplace or institutional routing.
entry_criteria: Stage 5 initial release stable in production.
exit_criteria: Advanced trading/automation feature set delivered incrementally with no regression to Stage 5 safety guarantees.
major_risks: Automation maturity outpacing risk-engine validation coverage.

purpose: Broaden charting/drawing/screener/platform capability toward closer TradingView-style parity, and add macOS/Linux if justified.
required_features_summary: Multi-chart layouts; advanced drawing tools; scan scheduling; Level II/DOM/hotkeys; macOS/Linux packaging (if promoted).
exit_criteria: TradingView-comparable charting/screening depth achieved for the platforms in active support.
dependencies: Stage 6; groundwork laid in Stage 0-1 (multi-chart layout model, drawing persistence, broader asset identifiers).

purpose: Private collaboration, creator profiles, and strategy-ecosystem groundwork (still not a public marketplace).
required_features_summary: Private teams; private collaboration; creator profiles; creator strategy versioning; verified performance.
excluded_features_summary: Public marketplace and public copy trading remain excluded.
exit_criteria: A verified, private strategy-sharing ecosystem operates safely.
major_risks: Unverified performance claims if verification mechanism is incomplete.

purpose: Long-range: public marketplace, global asset-class/regional expansion, institutional-grade features.
required_features_summary: Public strategy marketplace; global asset classes (forex/futures/international equities/bonds); institutional routing (if ever pursued).
excluded_features_summary: Nothing pre-excluded at this horizon, but every item remains Decision Pending until re-evaluated.
entry_criteria: Stage 8 ecosystem proven safe and valuable.
major_risks: Institutional/marketplace scope could dilute the deterministic-safety-first product identity if not carefully governed.
